title: 2026 November 17, 2026 Avino Announces Key Technical Appointment Arrow Right
body_markdown:
Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. (“Avino” or the “Company”) (ASM: TSX/NYSE American, GV6: FSE) is pleased to announce a key technical appointment to the management team as the Company moves forward with its transformational growth strategy.


**Appointment of Dr. Osbaldo Zamora, Ph.D., P. Geo., as Vice President, Exploration**


Dr. Osbaldo Zamora brings more than 25 years of international experience in mineral exploration, project management, and technical leadership across North and South America, particularly in Mexico, Canada, and Peru. In his new role, he will work closely with Avino’s executive and operations teams to refine the Company’s exploration strategy, advance its understanding of the geological systems, and identify opportunities for resource expansion and new discoveries.


Previously, Dr. Zamora held senior technical and management positions with Kuya Silver, Discovery Silver, Minera Adularia, Azucar Minerals, and Altiplano Minerals. His expertise includes precious and base metal exploration, geological modelling, and mineral resource evaluation, with particular emphasis on epithermal mineral systems.


Dr. Zamora holds a Ph.D. in Economic Geology from the University of Alberta and an M.Sc. in Petrology and Geochemistry from the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).


“We are pleased to welcome Osbaldo to the management team,” said David Wolfin, President and CEO. “Osbaldo’s extensive technical knowledge and experience will be invaluable as we continue to advance our understanding of the Avino and La Preciosa districts. His expertise will play an important role in supporting our exploration initiatives and identifying opportunities for future resource growth.”


‍ **About Avino:**


Avino is a silver producer operating in Durango, Mexico, with the goal of long-term sustainable and profitable mining operations to reward shareholders and the community alike through our growth at the historic Avino Property and the strategic acquisition of the adjacent La Preciosa Property. La Preciosa is one of the largest permitted silver assets in Mexico and is only 19 kilometres from the Avino mill. It is currently in the development stage, with 3,000 metres of underground development been completed to date. Avino’s inaugural proven and probable mineral reserves announced April2026 totaled 127 million silver equivalent ounces, and the updated measured and indicated mineral resource base is 301 million silver equivalent ounces. Avino is included in the Toronto Stock Exchange’s TSX30™ for the second consecutive year, having distinguished itself by being ranked in the 5th position in both2025 and 2026.As part of Avino’s commitment to adopting sustainable practices, we have been operating a dry-stack tailings facility for more than two years with excellent results. We are committed to managing all business activities in a safe, environmentally responsible, and cost-effective manner, while contributing to the well-being of the communities in which we operate. The Company’s silver, gold and copper production remains unhedged.
